items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: The interviewer introduces Bill Russell and asks the interviewee to give his full name; the interviewee responds only regarding his own name and his father's name, showing no personal interaction or relationship with Bill Russell.

ctx.x: 25th already, 1961. And this is Bill Russell. Do you mind giving your full name? Narvin Henry Kimball. I noticed in the old times, a lot of times people would call you Henry Kimball Jr., and your father, was his name also Narvin?
No, his name was Henry. Just Henry. And they would call me Henry because of my father. They would call me Little Henry, or they would call me Henry Kimball Jr.
